labels.name: Covered
labels.definition: The duty is one of T1–T6 done in a repeatable way.
labels.example: Review a sample of agent conversations each week and log failures.

labels.name: Assisted
labels.definition: NeoSigma prepares it, a person decides. Use this whenever a duty only partly matches a task.
labels.example: Define what a good answer looks like with our clinical team; decide which failures to prioritize.

labels.name: Not covered
labels.definition: Human work (managing people, customer calls, roadmap) or something outside T1–T6.
labels.example: Present findings to leadership; manage a team of annotators.

verification.name: The verification study
verification.claim: Calibrated checking reached a 0.768 failure-detection score at $1.30 per 900 sessions, about 47 times more sessions than the strongest single judge for the same budget.

self_improvement.name: The self-improvement study
self_improvement.claim: Agent score rose from 0.56 to 0.78 on a customer-service benchmark with no model change.

scaffolding_tax.name: The Scaffolding Tax study
scaffolding_tax.claim: The best harness depends on the model, so a model switch needs the setup re-tuned on the company's own tasks.
